name: Denirenicus Editor Tools
author: Denis Oparin

sections.description:
Denirenicus Editor Tools adds additional editing tools to the WordPress Classic Editor.

It provides tools for:

  • Info, Checked, Warning, and Error blocks.
  • Console, Snippet, PowerShell, and Output blocks.
  • Inline tools and formatting helpers.
  • Symbols.
  • Anchors.
  • Cite and keyboard-key formatting.
  • Marker and menu-item formatting.

The plugin is designed for the WordPress Classic Editor and uses the TinyMCE editor included with WordPress.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the denirenicus-editor-tools folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the Classic Editor and use the Denirenicus Editor Tools buttons.
sections.faq:
Does Denirenicus Editor Tools work with the Block Editor?

Denirenicus Editor Tools is designed for the WordPress Classic Editor.

Does the plugin replace the Classic Editor?

No. Denirenicus Editor Tools adds additional tools to the existing Classic Editor.
